title: Connect a new device
qr_app: QR code to pair the app
qr_web: QR code to sign in on the web
hint_app: Scan this code on the pairing screen of Persona on your phone. On a Mac or Android, you can also copy the pairing link and paste it.
hint_web: Scan it with a phone's camera to open it in the browser, or copy the sign-in link into a browser on another computer.
loopback: Only this computer can open this address. To sign in on another device, open the web page at the hub's address first, then make a code there.
paired_hint: It has its own credential now; you can revoke it on its own in the device list.
